external_collaboration.partner_name: Lielvarde District Music and Art School
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Singing together is a fundamental element in Latvia’s national identity. Some of the events that led to its independence in 1989 have since been labeled the “singing revolution”. The Lielvarde District Music and Art School brings with it this incredible tradition, in which whoever wishes to start studying music must learn music theory by singing in an ensemble.
